deals.travelWindow: Sep 5-12 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Allegiant, additional Sept-Oct dates run higher
deals.whyRanked: Holding steady at $97 RT nonstop for a second week — still the cheapest verified fare of the five — and the Smokies' Sugarlands entrance is under an hour away.
deals.soloWhy: Downtown's compact grid is easy to wander alone on foot, and the park's Sugarlands and Cades Cove areas are quiet enough on a weekday to hike solo without a crowd.

highlights: Ijams Nature Center's river bluffs and swimming hole
Market Square's restaurants and Saturday farmers market
World's Fair Park and the Sunsphere observation deck
Depot District breweries near the Old City
Great Smoky Mountains NP's Cades Cove loop road
itinerary: Day 1 — Ijams Nature Center for a river-bluff hike, Market Square for dinner and live music at night.
Day 2 — Sunsphere observation deck and World's Fair Park, then a self-guided brewery crawl through the Old City/Depot District.
Day 3 — Rent a car for the Smokies: Cades Cove's 11-mile wildlife loop at dawn, back to Knoxville for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown — Market Square, World's Fair Park, and the Old City — is entirely walkable; a rental car is required for the national park.
guide.stayArea: Downtown near Market Square — walkable to restaurants and a short drive from I-40.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 30 - Oct 5 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on United, other Sept-Nov dates run $217+
deals.whyRanked: $141 RT nonstop and back on the board after two quiet weeks, and Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor is 90 minutes from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Larimer Square and the Confluence Park trail network are flat and well-lit at night, and the free MallRide shuttle removes any guesswork about getting downtown.

highlights: Larimer Square's restored Victorian storefronts
Confluence Park where Cherry Creek meets the South Platte
Denver Central Market food hall
Denver Botanic Gardens
Rocky Mountain National Park's Bear Lake corridor
itinerary: Day 1 — Denver Central Market for lunch, Larimer Square in the afternoon, dinner and rooftop drinks nearby.
Day 2 — Denver Botanic Gardens in the morning, a walk or bike along Confluence Park and the Cherry Creek Trail, sunset from Cheesman Park.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Rocky Mountain NP: the Bear Lake corridor for an easy alpine hike, back to Denver for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: The free MallRide shuttle and A Line train cover downtown and the airport; a rental car is needed for the national park.
guide.stayArea: LoDo or Uptown — walkable to Larimer Square and a MallRide stop.

deals.travelWindow: Sep - early Dec 2026, cheapest confirmed one-stop fares on American, unchanged from a week ago
deals.whyRanked: Flat at $228 RT with one stop, and Channel Islands National Park's boats depart from nearby Ventura Harbor — one of the strongest park boosts of the five.
deals.soloWhy: The flat waterfront grid and a free electric shuttle make it easy to see the whole city without a car, and the Funk Zone's tasting rooms are built around solo counter seating.

highlights: Santa Barbara Botanic Garden's chaparral trails
Santa Barbara County Courthouse's sunken garden and tower view
Funk Zone wine and cider tasting rooms
Butterfly Beach at sunset
Channel Islands National Park boat trip to Anacapa Island
itinerary: Day 1 — Santa Barbara County Courthouse tower for the view, State Street in the afternoon, dinner in the Funk Zone.
Day 2 — Santa Barbara Botanic Garden in the morning, Butterfly Beach and Montecito's Coast Village Road at sunset.
Day 3 — Drive to Ventura Harbor for the Island Packers boat to Channel Islands National Park, back for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown and the waterfront are entirely walkable, with a free electric shuttle along State Street; a rental car is needed for the Ventura Harbor boat dock.
guide.stayArea: The Funk Zone or downtown near State Street — walkable to the wharf and tasting rooms.

deals.travelWindow: Sep 19-29 or Nov 5-11 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on Delta, Southwest, or JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: $247 RT nonstop across three carriers, and Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve's cliff trails are a 20-minute trolley-and-walk from downtown.
deals.soloWhy: Balboa Park and the Gaslamp Quarter are packed with solo counter-seating and museum-hopping, and the trolley covers most of the city without a rental car.

highlights: Balboa Park's museums and Spanish Village art studios
Cabrillo National Monument's tide pools and lighthouse
Gaslamp Quarter happy hours
La Jolla Cove seals and coastal walk
Torrey Pines State Natural Reserve cliff trails
itinerary: Day 1 — Balboa Park's museums and gardens in the morning, Gaslamp Quarter happy hour and dinner at night.
Day 2 — La Jolla Cove for the seals and a coastal walk, sunset at Torrey Pines' Razor Point trail.
Day 3 — Trolley and a short walk to Cabrillo National Monument's tide pools before an afternoon flight.
guide.gettingAround: The MTS trolley and rideshares cover downtown, Balboa Park, and La Jolla without a car; Torrey Pines and Cabrillo are easiest with one.
guide.stayArea: Gaslamp Quarter or Little Italy — walkable to a trolley stop and the waterfront.

deals.travelWindow: Oct 9-12 cheapest confirmed nonstop dates on JetBlue
deals.whyRanked: The priciest of the five at $248 RT nonstop with no national park close by, but Mammoth Cave National Park is a manageable day trip and downtown's honky-tonks make for an easy solo night out.
deals.soloWhy: Lower Broadway's honky-tonks are set up for solo bar-hopping with live music in every doorway, though a rental car is the only realistic way to Mammoth Cave.

highlights: Lower Broadway's honky-tonks and live music
Country Music Hall of Fame
Centennial Park and the Parthenon replica
The Gulch's shops and restaurants
Mammoth Cave National Park's cave tours
itinerary: Day 1 — Country Music Hall of Fame in the afternoon, Lower Broadway honky-tonks at night.
Day 2 — Centennial Park and the Parthenon in the morning, The Gulch for shopping and dinner in the evening.
Day 3 — Rent a car for Mammoth Cave National Park's Historic Tour, back to Nashville for an evening flight.
guide.gettingAround: Downtown, The Gulch, and Lower Broadway are walkable, with rideshares covering the rest; a rental car is needed for Mammoth Cave.
guide.stayArea: The Gulch or downtown — walkable to Broadway and restaurants.
